sources.name: GRB – Gebouw aan de grond (GRB:GBG), Digitaal Vlaanderen
sources.notes: WFS 2.0.0 GetFeature, typeNames GRB:GBG, native Lambert 72 (EPSG:31370). Building footprints in scenery.json (types, roof shape and height tags from OSM where matched). Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik.

sources.name: GRB – Wegopdeling (GRB:WGO), Digitaal Vlaanderen
sources.notes: WFS 2.0.0 GetFeature, typeNames GRB:WGO, 'rand van de rijbaan' (surveyed carriageway edge) lines. The route centreline is moved onto the middle of the surveyed carriageway (Gaussian-smoothed); per-way widths checked against them. Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik.

sources.name: Ronde van Vlaanderen 2025 roadmap (Flanders Classics)
sources.notes: Race direction and streets: Brugzavel, Broektestraat, Kwaremontplein, Schilderstraat, Ronse Baan (N36). Oude Kwaremont 2200 m, 4 % average, 11.6 % max, 1500 m of cobbles.
